{{Top}}
[[File:LarsHomestead-ChampionsOfTheForce.jpg|thumb|250px|A Tatooine moisture farm]]
{{Quote|Moisture farms are hot and lonely. And besides, they're all on miserable desert worlds, like Tatooine. End of discussion. Period.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Mission">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>}}
'''Moisture farms''' were often found on dry [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] or [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where the arid climate made [[Water/Legends|water]] a scarce commodity. 

Most moisture farms were owned and operated by single families, spread over a range of several square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. To function effectively, moisture vaporators had to be spread a minimum distance apart to collect water; two hundred and fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] was a guide on Tatooine to allow each GX-8 on the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] to collect about one and a half [[Liter/Legends|liters]] of water a [[Standard day/Legends|day]], although farms in drier areas closer to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] required a spacing of about five hundred meters.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Moisture farms were risky businesses to operate. Even a small water loss could mean the difference between surviving for another season or descending into bankruptcy. [[Moisture farmer/Legends|Moisture farmers]] maintained vaporators to gather water for themselves as well as to sell to others. They also used the gathered moisture to irrigate crops such as [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] in underground [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponic labs]],<ref name="EGWT" /> sheltered from the hot sun (or suns, as is the case in the [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] of [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo]]).

[[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]] maintained a [[Lars homestead/Legends|moisture farm]] on Tatooine, where he lived with his son [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and his second wife [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]]. Owen and his wife [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru]] later inherited the farm, and raised [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] there. Another moisture farmer was [[Orin Bold]].
